newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH INDUSTRIAL CLIMATE COOLS SLIGHTLY IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH INDUSTRIAL CLIMATE COOLS SLIGHTLY IN JULY.

text.p: Poland's industrial climate in the manufacturing sector eased slightly for the second straight month in July as demand and output forecast became more pessimistic, the Central Statistics Office (GUS) said.
In its monthly survey, GUS said the industrial climate index eased to 11 points in July from 12 points in June.
GUS said the construction sector climate index fell to 33 points in July from 45 points in June, mainly as a result of less pessimistic potfolios of future orders. @
The retail sector climate index rose by four points to eight points in July, pulled up by increasing sales and a better overall financial situation of retail firms.
The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies.
